cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You said 'nothing can go wrong' before balancing the key on the teacup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It fell into the cup. I dried it with the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And now the invitation has dissolved around the key to the wedding hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can still prise it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Your 'nothing' has become both the lock and the address we can't read.

mechanism: A supervises recovery of a wet key and damaged invitation until the earlier promise of independent access ends in needing the bride's address again.
confusable: D229 repeats one harmless blame detail; D240 brings several early details back in altered linked roles toward one consequence.
comparison: Access/address and paper damage differ from furniture/ceremony sequencing.
seedUse: Use key/cup/invitation chain, but do not turn unreadable paper into a literal lock or rely on unspecified scene geography.
